biotools.summary: Sequenoscope is a modular bioinformatics pipeline designed for analyzing Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) adaptive sampling sequencing data. It features modules for filtering raw reads, generating sequencing statistics, and visualizing data comparisons.
